entries.title: Luke 18:1
segments: ¶And he spoke also a parable to them to the purport that they should always pray and not faint,

entries.title: Luke 18:2
segments: saying, There was a judge in a city, not fearing God and not respecting man:

entries.title: Luke 18:3
segments: and there was a widow in that city, and she came to him, saying, Avenge me of mine adverse party.

entries.title: Luke 18:4
segments: And he would not for a time; but afterwards he said within himself, If even I fear not God and respect not man,

entries.title: Luke 18:5
segments: at any rate because this widow annoys me I will avenge her, that she may not by perpetually coming completely harass me.

entries.title: Luke 18:6
segments: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge says.

entries.title: Luke 18:7
segments: And shall not God at all avenge his elect, who cry to him day and night, and he bears long as to them?

entries.title: Luke 18:8
segments: I say unto you that he will avenge them speedily. But when the Son of man comes, shall he indeed find faith on the earth?

entries.title: Luke 18:9
segments: ¶And he spoke also to some, who trusted in themselves that they were righteous and made nothing of all the rest [of men], this parable:

entries.title: Luke 18:10
segments: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a tax-gatherer.

entries.title: Luke 18:11
segments: The Pharisee, standing, prayed thus to himself: God, I thank thee that I am not as the rest of men, rapacious, unjust, adulterers, or even as this tax-gatherer.

entries.title: Luke 18:12
segments: I fast twice in the week, I tithe everything I gain.

entries.title: Luke 18:13
segments: And the tax-gatherer, standing afar off, would not lift up even his eyes to heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, O God, have compassion on me, the sinner.

entries.title: Luke 18:14
segments: I say unto you, This [man] went down to his house justified rather than that [other]. For every one who exalts himself shall be humbled, and he that humbles himself shall be exalted.

entries.title: Luke 18:15
segments: ¶And they brought to him also infants that he might touch them, but the disciples when they saw [it] rebuked them.

entries.title: Luke 18:16
segments: But Jesus calling them to [him] said, Suffer little children to come to me, and do not forbid them, for of such is the kingdom of God.

entries.title: Luke 18:17
segments: Verily I say to you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.

entries.title: Luke 18:18
segments: ¶And a certain ruler asked him saying, Good teacher, having done what, shall I inherit eternal life?

entries.title: Luke 18:19
segments: But Jesus said to him, Why callest thou me good? There is none good but one, God.

entries.title: Luke 18:20
segments: Thou knowest the commandments: Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.

entries.title: Luke 18:21
segments: And he said, All these things have I kept from my youth.

entries.title: Luke 18:22
segments: And when Jesus had heard this, he said to him, One thing is lacking to thee yet: Sell all that thou hast and distribute to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in the heavens, and come, follow me.

entries.title: Luke 18:23
segments: But when he heard this he became very sorrowful, for he was very rich.

entries.title: Luke 18:24
segments: But when Jesus saw that he became very sorrowful, he said, How difficultly shall those who have riches enter into the kingdom of God;

entries.title: Luke 18:25
segments: for it is easier for a camel to enter through a needle's eye than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

entries.title: Luke 18:26
segments: And those who heard it said, And who can be saved?

entries.title: Luke 18:27
segments: But he said, The things that are impossible with men are possible with God.

entries.title: Luke 18:28
segments: And Peter said, Behold, *we* have left all things and have followed thee.

entries.title: Luke 18:29
segments: And he said to them, Verily I say to you, There is no one who has left home, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,

entries.title: Luke 18:30
segments: who shall not receive manifold more at this time, and in the coming age life eternal.

entries.title: Luke 18:31
segments: ¶And he took the twelve to [him] and said to them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written of the Son of man by the prophets shall be accomplished;

entries.title: Luke 18:32
segments: for he shall be delivered up to the nations, and shall be mocked, and insulted, and spit upon.

entries.title: Luke 18:33
segments: And when they have scourged [him] they will kill him; and on the third day he will rise again.

entries.title: Luke 18:34
segments: And they understood nothing of these things. And this word was hidden from them, and they did not know what was said.

entries.title: Luke 18:35
segments: ¶And it came to pass when he came into the neighbourhood of Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the wayside begging.

entries.title: Luke 18:36
segments: And when he heard the crowd passing, he inquired what this might be.

entries.title: Luke 18:37
segments: And they told him that Jesus the Nazaraean was passing by.

entries.title: Luke 18:38
segments: And he called out saying, Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me.

entries.title: Luke 18:39
segments: And those [who were] going before rebuked him that he might be silent; but *he* cried out so much the more, Son of David, have mercy on me.

entries.title: Luke 18:40
segments: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be led to him. And when he drew nigh he asked him [saying],

entries.title: Luke 18:41
segments: What wilt thou that I shall do to thee? And he said, Lord, that I may see.

entries.title: Luke 18:42
segments: And Jesus said to him, See: thy faith has healed thee.

entries.title: Luke 18:43
segments: And immediately he saw, and followed him, glorifying God. And all the people when they saw [it] gave praise to God.
